title: Reduced generic tensor and canonical map of DVR normalizations
statement: Let $D,T$ be commutative rings and $F,H,M$ fields with compatible maps $D\to T\to H$, $D\to F\to H$, and $D\to F\to M$ [def-pc-field-extension]. Define $E=(H\otimes_F M)/\sqrt{(0)}$, where $\sqrt{(0)}$ is the ideal of all nilpotent elements [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Let $R$ be the integral closure of $D$ in $M$ and $C$ the integral closure of $T$ in $E$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. The canonical normalization homomorphism $R\to C$ sends $m$ to the class of $1\otimes m$ in $E$, regarded as an element of $C$. It is well-defined because a monic equation over $D$ remains monic after mapping its coefficients to $T$. These constructions specialize to an injective local extension of discrete valuation rings [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring] with their fraction fields.

from.place: Canonical reduced generic tensor and normalization map used in the normalization-structure lemma; historical supporting algebra for the Epp construction.

lean.statement:
def eppNormalizationMap
    (D : Type u) (T : Type w) (F : Type v) (H : Type x) (M : Type y)
    [CommRing D] [CommRing T] [Field F] [Field H] [Field M]
    [Algebra D T] [Algebra D F] [Algebra D H] [Algebra T H] [Algebra F H]
    [IsScalarTower D T H] [IsScalarTower D F H]
    [Algebra F M] [Algebra D M] [IsScalarTower D F M] :
    integralClosure D M →+* eppUpperClosure T F H M
